note: Every model in the summary table is a single run. Nemotron is the only one run repeatedly. These are those runs, all on the identical four tasks with the identical hidden suites.

abgleich_series.question: Does asking the model to check the task statement point by point before finishing help?
abgleich_series.verdict: No effect measurable — and the series could not have measured one: 17 of 40 task runs hit the 80-turn limit, so the binding constraint was the turn budget, not the mechanism. The check itself costs turns from that same budget.
